_doc: AIEP GENOME SDK — Kernel Freeze Lock v1.0. Governed by AIEP Flexibility Contract §2 (Layer 0). Any modification to a locked field requires new LOCKFILE_VERSION and triggers version fracture per §9.

layer_0_locks._doc: Layer 0 — Kernel (Non-Negotiable). FC §2. Change any field here → new LOCKFILE_VERSION.

deterministic_engine._doc: FC §8: Output = f(A, C, P). For identical A,C,P output must be identical across machines, deployments, jurisdictions, time.

layer_1_capability_defaults._doc: Layer 1 — Capability Negotiation (FC §3). Default capability set for LOCKFILE_VERSION 1.0.0. Capabilities are versioned and selection is deterministic. New capabilities may be added without version fracture.

layer_2_policy_defaults._doc: Layer 2 — Policy Layer (FC §4). Policies are artefacts. Policies are hashed. Policy version is stored with arbitration output. Policy changes do not change protocol.

adapter_registry._doc: FC §6 — Adapter Doctrine. Permitted adapters. Adapters must be deterministic for given input, must not mutate kernel state, must not override arbitration result.

version_fracture_triggers._doc: FC §9 — Version Fracture Rule. Actions that require new GENOME version.

flexibility_test._doc: FC §11 — The Flexibility Test. A requested change is valid if it can be expressed as one of these. If it requires editing kernel logic it is a new protocol version.

mutation_rules.statement: No field in layer_0_locks may be modified in-place. Any change requires new LOCKFILE_VERSION. All downstream repos pinning this version will detect the change via kernel_bundle_hash mismatch.

replay_requirement.statement: Any two systems with identical Evidence Ledger, Reasoning Ledger, capability set C, policy set P, and LOCKFILE_VERSION MUST produce identical pack_hash. If they do not, one or both systems are non-conformant. Fail closed per FC §2.

security_invariants._doc: FC §10 — Security posture documented per version.
security_invariants.replay_attack_mitigation: AIEP-REPLAY-001 + schema_version_id + collection_ts in all commitments
security_invariants.registry_compromise_response: kernel_bundle_hash verification at startup; LOCKFILE mismatch triggers fail-closed
security_invariants.timeout_policy: AIEP-TIMEOUT-001: deterministic ops have no timeout; network ops carry schema-defined timeout
